questionnaire.title: ASSIST Screening Test
questionnaire.description: Screening test to assess substance use risk levels.

items.text: Tobacco products (cigarettes, chewing tobacco, cigars, etc.)
Inhalants (nitrous, glue, petrol, paint thinner, etc.)
Sedatives or sleeping pills (e.g., diazepam, alprazolam)

questions.text: In your life, which of the following substances have you ever used (non-medical use only)?
In the past three months, how often have you used the substances you mentioned?
During the past three months, how often have you had a strong desire or urge to use substances?
During the past three months, how often has your substance use led to health, social, legal, or financial problems?
During the past three months, how often have you failed to do what was expected of you because of substance use?
Has a friend, relative, or anyone else ever expressed concern about your substance use?
options: Yes, but not in the past 3 months

questions.text: Have you ever tried to cut down on using substances but failed?
options: Yes, but not in the past 3 months

questions.text: Have you ever used any drug by injection (non-medical use only)?
options: Yes, but not in the past 3 months
